Name: Autohooker
Author: deykfa
Description:
[size=4][font=Verdana]Have you ever had situation where you didn’t have time to catch fish when it bite? Maybe you just didn’t hear or see it?[/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Verdana]-[color=#ffff00]WHY DO I HAVE TO SIT AND LISTEN TO IT FLASHING? I WANT TO CATCH FISH, NOT LISTEN![/color][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Verdana]Then I have a brilliant offer for you, the Autohooker mod will save you from this hassle. This mod will do the work of fishing rod for you.[/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Verdana]You can adjust when exactly the rod will hook the fish. Maybe you like efficiency or you want to stretch the pleasure of a bitten fish as long as possible? Please, in the settings you can choose when exactly the mod will react. [/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Verdana]You may still have a question, [color=#ffff00]Is it fair to play with this mod?[/color] Don’t hesitate, you can turn off this mod at any time in the settings.[/font][/size]
[color=#ffffff][size=4][font=Verdana]Autohooker is savior of your fishing routine![/font][/size][/color]
[line]

The mod fixes what I consider to be an outdated mechanic of attracting the player's attention. When you start the game with this mod, it will hook the fish half a second after the [i]Hit![/i] inscription. This is all that can be expected from this mod, but if you want, you can increase or decrease the delay from 0 seconds, that is, immediately (it looks very sharp) to 0.8 seconds (the value from 0 to 0.8 seconds is the window when the player can press the key to hook the fish).
All settings can be made yourself by editing [color=#93c47d][font=Verdana]config.json[/font][/color] file located at [color=#93c47d][font=Verdana]Stardew Valley/Mods/Autohooker[/font][/color] or in the game in the menu or during the game via the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].

This mod performs only one function and provides the ability to configure it. If you need other functions to facilitate fishing, there is the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4806]Eidee Easy Fishing[/url], but my mod does not go beyond the vanilla game.

[b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]
For the mod to work correctly, it only needs the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] installed in the game.

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install Autohooker archive[/*]
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [color=#93c47d][font=Verdana]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font][/color][/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
